commands.command: cargo fmt --check && cargo test --test cli --locked --offline && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked --offline -- -D warnings

coverage.platform: macOS implementation-tested; other OS tuples STATE_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED
coverage.production_override: none; tests inject StateStore root directly
coverage.records: bounded MRU of three; closed provider and lower-hex 64 digest fields; literal ordered argv
coverage.privacy: secret-like argv refuses the entire save; no HOME or absolute project path field
coverage.unsafe_state: corrupt, symlink, permissive-mode and orphan temp refuse without replacement
coverage.durability: exclusive advisory lock; same-directory 0600 temp; file and directory sync; atomic rename
coverage.concurrency: four concurrent saves yield valid bounded state
coverage.deferred: no provider launch, automatic save, consent, chooser collapse, or non-macOS support claim
